Type: curved-back upholstered dining armchair
Use: dining, working at a desk; dining room, home office
Style: contemporary, mid-century modern, modern
Materials: felt-like fabric upholstery with channel stitching, stained wood legs
Colors: light cool grey, dark reddish brown wood
Shape: rounded barrel back flowing into arms, channel-tufted outer sides, padded seat, tapered wood legs exposed at front, medium weight
Feel: elegant, soft, tailored
Goes with: dark wood tables, white walls, warm neutrals; contemporary or mid-century dining rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Contemporary Curved-Back Dining Chair, 35"H, Felt Gray
product.description: The curved back and outside channel of this dining chair create an elegant touch to any room while providing comfortable support. Felt-gray fabric allows it to seamlessly fit into a number of decor schemes. The solid wood frame creates a sturdy dining seat. 24"W x 26"D x 35"H; seat height: 19"H; seat depth: 18"D; seat back height: 15"H 100% polyester fabric on solid wood frame Curved back with outside channel No assembly required Avoid moisture. Wipe with a soft, dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
